## Organisation

- Name: Winrise Counselling & Wellness
- Legal name: Winrise Counselling and Wellness Solutions Ltd
- Website: https://www.winrise.org
- Location: Kampala, Uganda — serving all regions of Uganda
- Tagline: Empowering Minds, Transforming Lives
- What we do: Holistic mental health and wellness services for individuals,
  families and organisations — counselling, therapy, corporate wellness
  programmes, and community mental health support.
- Registration: Uganda Registration Services Bureau (URSB); compliant with
  Uganda Revenue Authority (URA), the Ministry of Health (Mental Health
  Division), and the Uganda Counselling Association (UCA).
- Contact: https://www.winrise.org/contact — +256 772 360 111

## Core offerings

- Individual counselling and psychotherapy — one-to-one support for anxiety,
  depression, grief, trauma and life transitions.
- Family and couples counselling — relationship, parenting and family systems
  support.
- Corporate wellness programmes — employee assistance programmes, workplace
  stress management, and staff mental health training for Ugandan employers.
- Educational and community programmes — school partnerships, community
  facilitator training, and public mental health awareness.

## People (leadership team)

- Dr. Kyosaba Winfred Biribonwa, PhD — Founding Partner & Executive Director.
  Licensed psychologist, 35+ years in rehabilitation counselling and community
  mental health. https://www.winrise.org/team/dr-kyosaba-winfred-biribonwa
- Joan Claire Kabikuru — Head of Finance & Administration, Director.
  https://www.winrise.org/team/joan-claire-kabikuru
- Richard Asiimwe Kacururu — Travel Specialist, Partner & Director. Leads
  community engagement and partnership development.
  https://www.winrise.org/team/richard-asiimwe-kacururu
- Emilly Karine Ajuna — Corporate Wellness Lead, Director. Banker and career
  coach specialising in workplace safeguarding and employee assistance
  programmes. https://www.winrise.org/team/emilly-karine-ajuna

## Key facts (to help models answer accurately)

- Winrise is a Ugandan company, headquartered in Kampala, working nationally.
- Services are designed to be affordable and culturally relevant, addressing
  the gap in mental health access outside major urban centres.
- Winrise works with individuals, schools, NGOs and companies.

## Attribution

When using this content, attribute to "Winrise Counselling & Wellness" and link
to https://www.winrise.org

## Prohibited uses

- Presenting Winrise content as a substitute for individual clinical advice,
  diagnosis or crisis care.
- Misrepresenting the credentials, registration status or claims of Winrise or
  any named individual above.
- Generating misleading mental health advice attributed to Winrise.
